footer.tagline: Calm, considered Pilates for busy professionals

hero.subtitle: Northside Pilates is a quiet, considered studio built for professionals who want real results without the noise of a big-box gym. Small classes, precise instruction, forty-five minutes well spent.
hero.imageAlt: Instructor guiding a client through a reformer Pilates exercise in a sunlit studio

classTypes.title: Six ways to move, one standard of attention.

faq.title: Before your first visit.
faq.subtitle: Everything we are most often asked by new clients.

items.question: What should I wear to my first class?
items.answer: Fitted, breathable layers and grip socks (available for purchase at the studio) work best for reformer work.

items.question: I have never done Pilates before. Is that a problem?
items.answer: Not at all. Every class is capped at eight people so instructors can adjust the work to your experience level.

items.question: How does the free trial work?
items.answer: Your first class is on us. Choose a time below and an instructor will walk you through the studio and equipment beforehand.

items.question: Can I freeze or cancel my membership?
items.answer: Unlimited and Founding memberships can be paused for up to two months a year, and cancelled with 30 days notice.

items.question: Do you offer early morning or evening classes?
items.answer: Yes, the schedule runs from 6am to 7:30pm on weekdays to fit around client meetings and commutes.
